title: BioNuclei: domain-robust nuclear instance segmentation and quantification for fluorescence microscopy
description:
BioNuclei is open-source software for nuclear instance segmentation and per-nucleus quantification in 2-D fluorescence microscopy. It combines a Boundary U-Net with a seeded watershed decoder, per-nucleus measurements, quality control and an evidence-bound report, and runs as a Python package, a FastAPI service and a browser Lab.

On the BBBC039 held-out test split (50 images) the released checkpoint scores Dice 0.970 and aggregated Jaccard index 0.873. Each result records the checkpoint SHA-256, decoder, input hash and software version.

Research software. Not for clinical diagnosis.
